ITEM 1 | Dark brown roasted cubes with browned, slightly wrinkled skin and charred edges, firm and matte-to-glossy, piece size about 2-3 cm, arranged on the right side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-colored florets, soft and slightly moist with a rough, bumpy surface, scattered in small clusters among the greens and near the roasted cubes | 60
ITEM 3 | Fresh dark green leaves, glossy and wilted with a smooth surface and visible light-green veins, spread across the left center of the plate, covering about a quarter of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Short tubular pasta pieces, pale yellow-beige, smooth with a slight sheen, about 3-4 cm long, scattered among the leaves on the left edge | 25
ITEM 5 | Small dark reddish-purple pieces, soft and glossy, a few clustered among the leaves near the center | 10
